status: DRAFT - depends on METHODOLOGY_CHANGE_REQUEST_002 being ratified

unit_definition.run: one (workload, condition, repetition) unit. An AGGREGATION unit.
unit_definition.task_attempt: one execution of one task under one condition. The unit of EXECUTION and of quality scoring.
unit_definition.session: every task attempt is its own independent agent session. Workload E must never run its three scenarios inside one session - that would contaminate the context-accumulation measurement E exists to make.

cost_consequence.note: Raised as CR-002. The allocation is untouched; what was never stated is the unit.

comparability.rule: Every condition compares the same task ids, task-set version, corpora and configuration. The only permitted difference is the registered intervention.
prohibited: selecting a subset of tasks per condition
dropping a task to resolve an inconsistency
counting three outputs of one task as three independent task samples

ordering.rule: Within a repetition index, all C0 attempts for a task complete before any treatment attempt for that task.
ordering.combined_conditions: C2+C4 and C3+C4 execute only after both single conditions have reported.
